offer.text: Operator. Vantage Deep Industries extends a trial contract: one Expedition Service, no charge. Use it on open ground and a VDI drillship comes down for you. Terms: you report the result.

steps.objective: Collect the trial Expedition Service from the VDI agent
steps.lines: Issuing one Expedition Service. It is a tablet; keep it in your cargo. It is spent when the ship is called.

steps.objective: Call the drillship at the VDI survey clearing on Frontier Road, south of Dustline
steps.lines: Leave by the Frontier Gate and walk south onto Frontier Road. VDI keeps a survey clearing off the bay by the Dustline gate, past the Castoff stair pit; the board marks it. Any open ground off the road would do, away from gates, wrecks and stair pits. Use the Expedition Service there (double-click it, or put it on a hotkey). The ship lands thirteen metres ahead of you. Do not stand under it.

steps.objective: Report the call-out to the VDI agent in Dustline
steps.lines: Call-out logged. The ship is yours while it stands: its door opens to the control room, the terminal by the door runs the bore. Load batteries and gas cans before you go deep. Further Expedition Services: ten thousand Metal, at this unit.
